articles.title: Moon Mission Will Livestream in 4K Thanks to Space Lasers!
articles.summary: NASA's Artemis III astronauts will use SpaceX's Starlink lasers to beam super-clear 4K video from the Orion spacecraft. The mission is set for late 2027.

articles.title: Famous Eagle Mom Jackie Found Weak—But She's Getting Help!
articles.summary: Jackie, the bald eagle mom watched by millions on a live nest cam, was found weak and unable to fly. She's now being cared for at the Ojai Raptor Center in California.

articles.title: NASA's Wild New Ideas: Sunshades in Space and Robot Explorers!
articles.summary: NASA picked 17 far-out projects for its 2026 NIAC program, including a dust cloud to cool Earth and tiny robots to explore Saturn's rings. Each gets money to study if the idea could work.
